seller_or_subject: Trustpilot — Kyle, 2-year seller, upcoming US sales tax
what: Seller using Payhip for about two years as Shopify alternative for digital and physical products. Notes Payhip handles UK VAT and states upcoming US sales tax support in April 2026.
verbatim_snippet: "I have been using Payhip for about two years and it's a great alternative to Shopify. When you start a business, you're not really able to pay a monthly subscription. Payhip only charges a tiny percent on what you sell. They take care of UK vat but in April will be able to do US sales too. Their support is very helpful and responsive. For me, it's been a great option for digital and physical products."
